paper_title: The NANOGrav 15-year Data Set: Search for Signals from New Physics
coupling_convention: d_e, dimensionless dilaton-like scalar coupling to the electron mass term (as plotted on y-axis of Fig. 14)
notes: NANOGrav 15-yr new-physics paper reports new 95% credible upper limits on ULDM scalar couplings d_e (photon), d_me (electron), d_mhat (quark), d_g (gluon), d_mu (muon) over ~1e-24 to 1e-20 eV (Fig. 14), plus vector ULDM (Fig. 15), assuming local DM density 0.4 GeV/cm^3. The pre-analysis hint suggests ScalarElectron (d_me), consistent with the abstract stating limits outperform atomic clock/torsion balance bounds for electron coupling. However, the paper simultaneously constrains multiple coupling types, and NO numerical limit values are available in the provided text — all limits are shown only as plot curves in Figs. 13-15 with no tables. Therefore data_points is empty and extraction confidence is low. Digitization of Fig. 14 (d_me panel, correlated/uncorrelated red lines) would be required to obtain values. | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: Traced red solid 'Correlated' 95% credible upper limit on d_e from Fig. 14 (top-middle panel), assuming ULDM is all of DM with rho_phi = 0.4 GeV/cm^3.
